g.text: Pulses with a rightward net endpoint (%)
Each colored dot is the percentage of that fly's 80 pulses ending with a positive heading shift.
Direction of pulse endpoints for each VES041 fly
Vertical reference: 50% rightward endpoints. No turn-amplitude or walking-speed threshold is applied.
Black diamonds: genotype means with 95% bootstrap intervals across flies.
Pooled 34 flies: 49.2% rightward, 95% CI 45.0% to 53.5%; 1338 rightward and 1382 leftward pulses.
